acceptance.line: - 2026-09-06 · cowork · POSTFIX-GATE BRIEF (PR #34, rebuild/m2-postfix-brief @ 45d52cb, base 811d1c0; exactly two Markdown files under rebuild/m2; no code, queue, ledger or dependency change) ACCEPTED as the successor-acceptance CONTRACT for the first repair package (D33/D34/D35 import guards, 8+3+2 = 13 estimated hours per the register) — resolves the successor-gate portion of OPEN-FIX/OPEN-V4 only; M2-FIX still needs the owner's own disposition and the theme's behaviour/delta brief; no runner exists yet and the first implemented run must report BASELINE PASS / FIXES PENDING. Checked against the real sources: every citation is exact (run-defect-laws.cjs 27–33 key-sorting snapshot and 46–70 inspect/parity; helpers.cjs 31–58 B adapter forms and patch/__auditOriginal; migrate-source 15–37, merge-source 21–24, writers-source 32–34 whole-module pins; second-gate.mjs 40–54/108–144/159–163; engine-test.jsx 8388–8391 migrate(null) → isPristineSeed true; second-gate-carrier 46–49 ghSync and 155–157 marker; app.jsx @ fe516c1 13242–13251 restore, 13270–13272 boot, 16217 pristine9, 22161–22174 forced-import policy; frozen source blob f98671d823f0d8cd83e730cdd930afe5f5e7b628; the three V4 law ids exist; the D34 seed does Object.assign(T.SEED, …) so it cannot serve as the unmodified-SEED positive; 0c3e7ce:rebuild/t3/REPORT-CLAUDE.md §6 retrievable). The mechanics are sound and fail-closed: the original 45-law runner, seeds, goldens, oracle and second gate stay untouched; a separately named runner under rebuild/conform/v4/postfix with BASELINE/PACKAGE phases; per-ID disposition UNRULED/APPROVED-FIX/KEEP/DEFER filled only from recorded rulings, PRESENT only with APPROVED-FIX, exit 2 without authorization; on-disk mutants in disposable copies executed in fresh processes; every output difference must match exactly one reviewed delta, no wildcard; any delta reaching a census value, receipt, assertion site or DTO stops for a scoped expectation amendment; unapproved incidental changes = UNAPPROVED-DELTA blocker. TWO ADDITIONS, binding for the implementation (not a re-review of the docs): (1) authorization citations are verified mechanically — the manifest pins each cited owner/cowork ledger line by its sha256 and the runner confirms that exact line is present in rebuild/DECISIONS.md at candidateBase (git show), a citation file's existence proves nothing; (2) the queued non-D obligations are enumerated in the manifest as fixed IDs with their source (ledger line / report section) — "later received" objections enter only through a successor manifest version. cowork's own practice from here: the M2-RULE line will enumerate every approved ID explicitly so per-ID citations resolve.
